en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own family and compare infant care, a helper and grandparent help in the same way
en.runTitle: Tampines, baby due February 2027: infant care, a helper or grandparents on S$11,500 a month?

fields.label: Baby’s due/birth date, citizenship and birth order
fields.value: Baby due February 2027; one parent is a Singapore citizen and the other a Singapore PR

fields.label: Parents’ applicant and employment details, including bonus-inclusive income
fields.value: Dual income, combined gross household income S$11,500 a month; both return to full-time work when the baby is about 6 months old

fields.label: Home and work locations and collection hours
Written fees, subsidy award and place or start-date status
fields.placeholder: e.g. a centre’s written infant fee of S$1,300 a month and a place offered from August 2027

fields.label: Available Baby Gift and CDA balances
fields.placeholder: e.g. S$3,000 Baby Bonus cash gift received and S$0 in the CDA so far

fields.label: Willing backup adults
fields.placeholder: e.g. the baby’s grandmother, three weekdays a week

en.template: Help us compare infant care, a helper and grandparent support using {baby}, {parents}, {places}, {fees}, {cda} and {backup}. Separate recurring cost, upfront cash and finite grants; make a leave-to-work calendar and a delayed-place backup. Ask before contacting anyone, submitting forms or sharing personal documents.

phases.title: Check current and announced subsidy rules, centre fees and the helper and grandparent options
phases.note: Infant-care subsidies, Baby Bonus, helper levy, centre fees near Tampines
phases.judgment: It found that the 2027 rules change the family’s numbers. Official tables already list new infant-care subsidies from 1 January 2027: S$600 Basic plus S$100 Additional, S$700 a month at their income. It also corrected a figure it had been handed: the 2027 per-person income ceiling is S$3,400, not S$3,750.

phases.title: Write the guide and source list, with the centre shortlist, fee caps and timeline
phases.judgment: The monthly fee is stated as conditional: it holds only if the baby is a citizen, the working parent qualifies, full subsidy is approved and the centre charges GST. It found no cut to 2027 infant fee caps, so current caps are a planning basis, not a centre quote.

phases.title: Recompute every money figure independently and check the page on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: An independent reviewer recomputed the numbers: all 42 calculation checks passed, covering 75 money amounts. It did not give a blanket pass either, keeping on record that some pages were read through a browser that was not provably fresh and signed-out.

workers: Found Tampines infant-care centres and the full-day infant fees they publish on their own pages, with the date of each fee
Read the official subsidy tables, fee caps and 2027 announcements, and worked out the monthly cost at this household income
Independently recomputed every money figure in the guide and checked claims against the source list

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你们家的情况，用同样的方式比较婴儿托管、请女佣和祖辈帮忙
zh.runTitle: 住在 Tampines，宝宝 2027 年 2 月出生：家庭月收入 11,500 新元，选婴儿托管、女佣还是祖辈帮忙？

fields.label: 宝宝预产期或出生日期、公民身份和胎次
fields.value: 宝宝预产期 2027 年 2 月；一位家长是新加坡公民，另一位是永久居民

fields.label: 父母申请人和工作资料及含花红收入
fields.value: 双职工，家庭月总收入 11,500 新元（税前）；宝宝约 6 个月大时两人都回到全职工作

fields.label: 住家工作地点和接送时间
书面收费、补贴批额及学位开始日期状态
fields.placeholder: 例如：某托婴中心书面报价每月 1,300 新元，学位 2027 年 8 月开始

fields.label: 可用 Baby Gift 和 CDA 余额
fields.placeholder: 例如：已收到 3,000 新元婴儿花红现金，CDA 目前余额 0 新元

fields.label: 愿意帮忙的后备成人
fields.placeholder: 例如：宝宝的外婆，每周三个工作日

zh.template: 请根据{baby}、{parents}、{places}、{fees}、{cda}及{backup}，比较婴儿托管、女佣和祖辈支持。分开持续费用、前期现金和有限津贴，排出休假到复工的日历，并准备学位延迟方案。联系任何人、提交表格或分享个人资料前，先问我们。

phases.title: 查证现行和已公布的补贴规则、托婴中心收费，以及女佣和祖辈照顾的选项
phases.note: 婴儿托管补贴、婴儿花红、女佣税、Tampines 一带的中心收费
phases.judgment: 它发现 2027 年的新规会改变这个家庭的数字：官方表格已列出 2027 年 1 月 1 日起的新婴儿托管补贴，基本补贴 600 新元加额外补贴 100 新元，按他们的收入每月共 700 新元。它还纠正了别人给的一个数字：2027 年人均收入上限是 3,400 新元，不是 3,750 新元。

phases.title: 写出指南和来源清单，附中心候选名单、收费上限和时间表
phases.judgment: 每月费用写明是有条件的：宝宝须是公民、工作的家长须符合资格、补贴须全额获批、中心须收消费税才成立。它没有找到 2027 年婴儿托管收费上限下调的消息，因此现有上限只作规划参考，不是中心报价。

phases.title: 独立重算每一笔金额，并检查电脑和手机上的页面
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事重新计算了数字：42 项计算检查全部通过，涉及 75 个金额。他也没有给出笼统的“全部通过”，而是保留记录：部分网页是通过无法证明处于干净状态的浏览器读取的。

workers: 找出 Tampines 一带的婴儿托管中心及其官网公布的全日婴儿收费，并记下每项收费的日期
读取官方补贴表、收费上限和 2027 年公告，算出这个收入水平下的每月费用
独立重算指南里的每一笔金额，并对照来源清单检查说法
